title: Super pour moi
body:
Très contente de cette appli de routine avec Timer. J’ai comparé avec plusieurs autres et c’est la plus pratique à utiliser dans le quotidien selon moi. 
J’apprécie vraiment les fonctionnalités accessibles avec un compte gratuit, c’est vraiment génial merci beaucoup !

- La possibilité d’enchaîner automatiquement ou manuellement les tâches est très pratique. 
- Pouvoir choisir le type de timer qui nous parle le plus est agréable à l’utilisation. 
- Je trouve aussi génial de pouvoir s’inspirer des routines de personnes connues notamment dans le développement personnel. 
- Je trouve juste dommage qu’une routine nocturne qui se termine après minuit soit automatiquement enregistrée sur le lendemain soir, du coup on doit restaurer la série ou perdre l’effet cumulé des routines ce qui est un peu frustrant.

En résumé ; application très pratique, agréable et intuitive que je recommande !

title: The best app for ADHD/autistic people in need of structure
body:
I’m autistic and when I’m alone I have trouble meeting my daily needs and responsibilities either because I don’t think about them, because I don’t realise how long they take, or because I get side tracked easily. This app remedies all those problems!

It’s the first time I ever pay a subscription for an app and it’s quite amazing. I use it every day when my spouse is away and thanks to that I can maintain a healthy schedule, feed myself on time, get enough sleep, etc. 

I do have a small bug though: whenever the app is launched (in the background or not), it increases the sound of all notifications. So for example if I’m on the app and I receive a text, the notification is painfully loud even though my settings say it’s at the lowest possible sound level. Same with the sounds on the app, they sometimes get incredibly loud and I have yet to find a pattern to this. I’m on iOS 16.5.1 with an iPhone 12. 

But anyways, apart from this small bug the app is absolutely amazing and 100% worth the money! To the developers: you guys are awesome!

title: La meilleure application pour être productif !
body:
Sincèrement, après l’installation des dizaines applications du même genre, enfin une application qui me correspond parfaitement malgré des pistes d’améliorations possibles ! 
Les + :
- Sa possibilité d’ajouter un compte à rebours pour respecter les timings 
- Un design épurée
- Prise en main facile 
- Une version gratuite complète 
- Des notifications vocales pour nous rappeler qu’une tâche vient de se finir 

Les Améliorations:
- Possibilité de mettre le compte à rebours sur la page de verrouillage de l’iPhone pour faciliter l’accès à l’application et connaître le temps restant ( j’espère vraiment voir une mise à jour sur ce sujet car c’est le point noir de Routinery)
- Des widgets indiquant le décompte du compte à rebours / des prochaines tâches à réaliser

Les - :
- Pas la possibilité d’acheter l’application à vie

title: BUG APPLE WATCH
body:
Hello, I love your app and find very useful (using 1 star to get attention..)

BUG: on the Apple Watch app, after completing a routine (routine shown in menu as gray and with the mention “done”) it is impossible to restart the routine. When asked:
 “The routine has been completed. Shall we clear the old record and restart it”

     “Cancel”.               “Restart”

If “restart” is pressed the app exits and comes back to the watch face.
This bug is annoying because it prevents the Apple Watch and your app to be used on standalone (without the IPhone), since to clear the bug the iPhone app has to be opened. 

Thank you for your time, hoping to see a bug fix soon ;)
author: Jonas Rayet

title: I love the idea but…
body:
I honestly think the routine idea in this app is terrific! Also the inspirations from people is very motivating- I haven’t found an app that gets close to this one. I also like the design!
However, notifications do not work (I have an iphone XS max, dont know if that’s related) which is very annoying because I don’t check my phone every minute and often forget to validate each step. In the end, I end up with very long steps that I finished a long time ago and I can’t edit the durations. So my stats are not reliable at all and it’s difficult to keep track of an entire day routine for example…
Some features also have a weird UX, it’s not intuitive how to skip VS postpone and the wrong translations don’t help

Conclusion: huge potential and it would deserve a 5-star if there were no such constraints as the ones mentioned above…In the meantime, I don’t find it efficient to keep using it everyday but I hope the app gets better so I can get back to it
author: lucyInParis

title: Practical. Purpose-driven. And awesome design!
body: I discovered Routinery 2 days ago with other apps. I downloaded 5 of them, tested 2 and Routinery changed the game. What I find fascinating is that it builds courage to get things done. I can see my day in a screen. When the countdown starts, it remain visible during the time-block. I wanted to get 90% of the day done by 12:00 and the challenge  is fun with Routinery. If I continue the challenge for a couple of days, for sure Routinery is my go-to App. At last, when I read that the developers use B.J Fogg (Standford behavior scientist) philosophy, It took me 3 seconds to be on board. Well done, the design is beautiful, minimalist and so experiential.
author: Hemle33

title: Thank you for this lovely routine & habits app !
body:
I love this app and its simplicity! The design is lovely, the features are just perfect and I love the fact that there are no unnecessary gimmicks that make everything complicated and overwhelming (complexity and having too much unnecessary information are the last things you need when trying to build new habits). 

If there was one feature I would love to have is having the possibility for a habit to last more than 12 hours - I’d be  using that to plan my weekly 36h fast. For now I just created a routine with a 12h fasting habit that I am repeating 3 times, and that works too. 

Thank you for creating this app! 🤍

title: Procrastinator No More!
body: I have tried many premium productivity apps over the years. From habit trackers, to to-do lists. This is the first app I have ever come across that gets me doing EVERYTHING I have set out to do! I complete every task or habit I have decided to start. Since it has a timer, It makes me do them without even thinking - therefore I end up just getting things done without having to talk myself out of getting started. And I mean, things I have struggled for years to implement into a daily routine. I genuinely appreciate the prompts i.e ‘Good morning’, Good night’, ‘How are you’, ,Ready to start your day’. I feel like I’m virtually and subtly being pushed towards achievement. Every time I complete a routine and see the ‘Well done’ message, it has a wonderful feel to it. I accomplish so much now and I have built up my confidence just through using the app. As though now I have the power to do, and continue to do (which has never been my mindset). I would give up so easily or talk myself out of even getting started. Now I look forward to hitting ‘done’ as the timer ends on the task. This app is simplistic and the UI is beautiful. It has worked to help me just get the job done.  Congratulations guys! You’ve helped me tremendously in organising my life! Thank you so much! Thank you so very much!
